title: Representable but Unlearned: Encoding Rank and the Interaction-Prediction Floor
abstract: arXiv:2609.36208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Input encodings can restrict which measured contrasts a predictor can jointly reproduce, even when no single contrast is forced to vanish. We compute the attainable contrast space from an encoder's equivalence classes and a fixed contrast design, without labels, loss, or a fitted model; projecting the recorded contrasts onto that space gives an empirical error floor for any unrestricted decoder on those classes. On a 140-rectangle siRNA interaction panel, a graph neural network's training-only feature mask merges 165 endpoint states into 90 classes and cuts the rank of the 140 interaction contrasts to 72. The resulting floor is 0.009980, which is 14.6% of the fitted model's interaction squared error; the fitted model reaches 0.068335, slightly worse than a control predicting no interaction at all. A minimum of three restored chemistry columns recovers full rank. Refitting without the mask removes the floor entirely, yet interaction MSE

translated_title: 可表示却学不到：编码秩与交互预测的误差下限
translated_abstract: 输入编码会限制预测器能够联合再现哪些测量对比，即使没有任何单一对比被强制归零。我们无需标签、损失函数或已拟合的模型，仅从编码器的等价类和固定的对比设计出发，即可计算出可达对比空间；将记录的对比投影到该空间上，便可为这些等价类上的任何无约束解码器给出经验误差下限。在一个包含140个矩形的siRNA交互面板上，图神经网络中仅用于训练阶段的特征掩码将165个终点状态合并为90个类，并将140个交互对比的秩削减至72。由此产生的误差下限为0.009980，占拟合模型交互平方误差的14.6%；而拟合模型本身的误差达到0.068335，略差于完全不预测任何交互的对照基线。只需最少恢复三个化学列即可恢复满秩。移除掩码后重新拟合可完全消除该下限，但交互MSE……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需标签或拟合模型即可量化输入编码秩缺陷所致预测误差下限的方法，并证明siRNA交互预测中仅训练期特征掩码造成的秩下降（140降至72）会产生占拟合模型误差14.6%的不可逾越下限，而仅恢复三个化学列或移除掩码即可完全消除该下限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a label-free method for computing the attainable contrast space and quantifying the prediction error floor induced by encoding rank deficiency, showing that a training-only feature mask in siRNA interaction prediction cuts the contrast rank from 140 to 72 and imposes an error floor worth 14.6% of the fitted model's error, which can be fully eliminated by restoring just three chemistry columns or removing the mask.
